# Virtual City School

> Virtual City School (VCS) is a live online school teaching the Cambridge O Level and A Level curriculum (alongside Grade 5-12 curricula), based in Saudi Arabia and serving expatriate Pakistani families across the Gulf and beyond.

Classes are live and taught in real time by qualified subject teachers - not pre-recorded video. VCS exists for families whose local Pakistani-curriculum schools don't offer a Cambridge track, and for families facing long waiting lists, high tuition, or no nearby seat at all in their country's British-curriculum schools. Class times are set in Arabian Standard Time (AST, UTC+3) / Gulf Standard Time (GST, UTC+4 for the UAE and Oman) and scheduled to work across the served countries.

## Subjects and levels

- **Cambridge O Level / IGCSE**: Mathematics, Additional Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, English Language, Urdu, Islamiyat, Pakistan Studies.
- **Cambridge AS Level & A2 Level**: Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Computer Science, English Language, Urdu.
- **Pakistani Federal Board (Matric/SSC, Grade 9-10 and FSc/ICS/FA, Grade 11-12)**: for families who need the Federal Board track rather than Cambridge.
- **Grade 5-12 general curriculum**: primary- and middle-school subjects on the Cambridge Curriculum for students not yet at O Level.

Live class schedules and current per-course pricing are on the [Courses](https://virtualcityschool.com/courses) page - the catalog changes as courses open and close, so treat that page as the source of truth rather than this file.

## Country guides

Country-specific pages on local schooling options, waiting lists, and why O Level/A Level fits each market, written for Pakistani expatriate families:

- [Saudi Arabia](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school/saudi-arabia): Virtual City School's home country; families in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, Khobar and smaller industrial cities with no Cambridge school nearby.
- [UAE](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school/uae): For families on a KHDA/ADEK school waiting list, or commuting between emirates for a seat.
- [Qatar](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school/qatar): Doha's smaller, more competitive private-school market.
- [Kuwait](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school/kuwait): Kuwait's long-settled Pakistani community and its private-school licensing environment.
- [Bahrain](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school/bahrain): Manama and Isa Town families choosing between the Pakistani Federal Board track and Bahrain's oversubscribed British-curriculum schools.
- [Oman](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school/oman): Families across Muscat, Sohar, Nizwa, Salalah, Buraimi and Sawiq, outside Oman's Muscat-concentrated British-curriculum schools.
- [Online School by Country (hub)](https://virtualcityschool.com/online-school): Index of all country guides above.

## Courses and people

- [Courses](https://virtualcityschool.com/courses): Cambridge O Level, AS Level and A2 Level courses, plus Grade 5-12 curricula, with live class schedules and per-course pricing.
- [Teachers](https://virtualcityschool.com/teachers): Qualified subject teachers, each currently or previously teaching at recognised institutions.
- [Exam Dates & Deadlines](https://virtualcityschool.com/exam-dates): Cambridge O Level and A Level exam registration deadlines and results dates, sourced from Cambridge International.
- [About](https://virtualcityschool.com/about): Virtual City School's mission and story.
- [Blog](https://virtualcityschool.com/blogs): Articles on online learning, Cambridge curricula, and education topics relevant to expatriate families.
